newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH BANKS BID TO PLACE PLN 45 MLN AT DRAINAGE.
newsitem.headline: POLISH BANKS BID TO PLACE PLN 45 MLN AT DRAINAGE.

text.p: Polish banks bid to place 45 million zlotys, in nominal terms, at the National Bank of Poland's reverse NBP-bill repurchase auction against a 150 million zloty offer, the NBP said.
Polish banks also bid for 82 million zlotys of 91-day NBP-bills against the central bank's 150 million zloty offer.
Results of the auction should be available at about 1300 local time. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
